Standalone MIT resource compiler fixtures from:
https://github.com/joshuaswarren/omarchy-apple-dev
Revision: 66a11a37dfc0bfb755d04bde1ecbeedc17753b3b

ibtool, nibarchive.py and keyorder.py are unmodified upstream files used for
hermetic compilation and binary NIBArchive inspection in regression tests.
LICENSE contains the upstream MIT permission notice.

The production installer obtains the same pinned sources and applies the exact
SHA-256-checked PATCH_IBTOOL from resource-tools/runtime.ts. The tests apply that
same patch to a temporary fixture copy. No xtool executable or API is used.
